newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Kader mulls share sale to third party.
newsitem.headline: Kader mulls share sale to third party.

text.p: Toymaker Kader Holdings Co Ltd said on Friday it was in talks to sell shares to a third party but no agreement had been reached.

"The company has commenced negotiation with an independent third party in relation to the acquisition of certain equity interest in the company which may or may not result in the issue of new shares of the company," Kader said in a statement.
"The negotiation is only at a preliminary stage and may or may not materialise. It should be stressed that no binding agreement has been reached," it said.
Kader shares were up HK$0.06 at HK$1.93 in early trade.
